title: Sellers run the lows, buyers take the group back
premise: Watch the group profiles as the market slides. One group stabs under the low of the three before it, closes back above, and its heaviest row sits near the top where buyers out-traded sellers. That is the BUY ▲.

chapters.title: FIGHT NODE
chapters.text: A FIGHT node at 26,523.17–26,524.33: 481 contracts, 4.1σ above the group's average row, 237 bought against 244 sold. Both sides committed at one price.

chapters.title: BUY ▲
chapters.text: The group dips under 26,469.75, the low of the three groups before it, and closes back above. Delta flips −513 → +243; the POC (26,488.98–26,490.32) sits in the top 35%, where buyers out-traded sellers.
